vacancies.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
vacancies.descriptionText:
🔵Project Description:

We're looking for a senior Full-Stack Developer (Java + React) to join our client's team and help build a new AI-enabled application platform. The team works with modern AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and generative AI, and cares about clean code, agile methods and high-quality delivery. The client is in the investment banking industry, and the platform supports collateral and margin management.

🔵Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain scalable back-end services and APIs using Java (Spring Boot)

Build responsive, high-performance front-end applications using React and TypeScript

Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to speed up delivery while keeping quality and security high

Design and integrate generative AI features into business applications, including prompt engineering, LLM integration and evaluation of model outputs

Define and consume RESTful APIs, and communicate requirements and constraints clearly across teams

Advise and guide the team on architecture, design decisions and best practices, including the responsible use of AI tools

Mentor developers and raise the team's technical level through code reviews and pair programming

Translate business and product requirements into robust end-to-end technical solutions

Apply clean code principles and help improve engineering standards, tooling and CI/CD pipelines

Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) on both front end and back end

Take an active part in agile ceremonies (Scrum/Kanban), including refinement, planning, reviews and retrospectives

Work closely with QA, product managers, architects and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality work that fits business needs

Support and improve existing applications in a fast-paced, enterprise investment-banking environment

🔵Mandatory Skills Description:

At least 8 years of professional software development experience, including long-term projects

Strong hands-on experience with Java (Java 11+) and Spring / Spring Boot

Strong hands-on experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML and CSS

Proven experience delivering full-stack features end to end, from UI to back-end services and the database

Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants in daily development

Practical knowledge of generative AI and prompt engineering, including integrating LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Azure OpenAI) into applications

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows

Clean coding skills

Excellent problem-solving skills

Familiarity with agile practices (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)

Good communication skills and the ability to state requirements clearly to other teams

🔵Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Experience in automated testing (JUnit, Jest, React Testing Library or similar)

Experience in investment banking or capital markets

Exposure to RAG architectures, vector databases or AI agent frameworks

Working knowledge of Unix/Linux and shell scripting

🔵Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

🔵Our Benefits:

💼 Employment & Compensation

- Stable employment based on an employment contract
- Copyright-based remuneration for Developers, resulting in a higher net salary
🏥 Health & Well-being

- LuxMed private health and dental care
- Life and travel insurance
- MyBenefit program (sports card, well-being initiatives, and more)
- Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, including psychological consultations, coaching sessions, and support in personal matters
🚗 Everyday Convenience

- Car rental options
🎓 Learning & Development

- Access to the LuxTalent platform, offering webinars, training sessions, and certified courses
🌍 Career Growth & Mobility

- Internal Mobility Program, enabling rotation between projects, locations, and accounts
…and much more!

vacancies.title: Frontend Angular Developer
vacancies.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Evidence Software department at Motorola Solutions is a leading provider of Digital Asset and Evidence Management Solutions. Our team is responsible for end-to-end software development, including design, implementation, testing, delivery, and maintenance of software leveraged by public safety and enterprise applications worldwide.

Job Description

As a Frontend Developer in our team, you will play a key role in designing, modernizing, and maintaining state-of-the-art web applications. While Angular is our core frontend framework, you will bring high flexibility and adaptability across different technologies, driving architectural excellence, performance, and resilience.

- Architect, build, and optimize responsive, high-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences.
- Maintain and modernize existing Marionette.js application, ensuring its ongoing reliability, security, and functional value.
- Partner closely with cross-functional team members to design and implement robust, scalable frontend solutions.
- Take ownership of complex frontend technical challenges, guiding them independently from concept to full resolution.
- Adapt dynamically to changing requirements and seamlessly integrate with adjacent technologies across the software stack.
- Write and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to guarantee high quality and code resilience.
- Engage actively in code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and fostering continuous technical improvement.
- Stay ahead of modern frontend development trends, tools, and best practices to keep our stack innovative and efficient.

Basic Requirements

- 3 to 5 years of hands-on commercial experience crafting high-impact frontend or full-stack software solutions.
- Deep expertise in Angular, paired with an open, versatile mindset and eagerness to adapt to other modern frontend frameworks.
- Valuable exposure to backend development, modern DevOps practices, or software build systems that helps you see the bigger technical picture.
- A collaborative and proactive mindset with strong analytical problem-solving skills to overcome complex technical challenges.
- Solid mastery of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript building blocks.
- Proven experience working with RESTful APIs and modern asynchronous programming concepts.
- A keen eye for UI/UX principles and passion for turning sleek designs into seamless user experiences.
- Confidence navigating modern version control systems, especially Git.

Nice to Have

- Experience with modern end-to-end and frontend testing frameworks such as Playwright, Jasmine, Karma, or Cypress.
- Experience with build tools and continuous integration environments (e.g., Webpack, Gulp, Jenkins).
- A security-conscious mindset, knowledgeable in mitigating vulnerabilities like XSS and CSRF.
- Commitment to accessibility standards (WCAG) to build web applications that are inclusive and accessible for everyone.

What We Offer

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your work, you’ll get the following:

- Contract of Employment (UoP)
- Private medical coverage, Multisport
- Life insurance (two annual incomes),
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan – 15% discount for buying Motorola’s Stock units,
- Employee Pension Plan – 3,5 % of the month’s salary gross, which goes to the retirement account
- IP Tax Relief (up to 80%)
- Yearly salary increase (depends on individual performance)
- Yearly bonus (depends on company performance)
- Flexible working hours (usually the day starts between 7-10),
- 8 hours working day (30 minutes lunch break included).
- Hybrid work mode (one to two times from the KRK office per week)

Travel Requirements

None

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

No

Company

Motorola Solutions Systems Polska Sp.z.o.o

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

vacancies.title: Senior SAP HCM Frontend Developer with German
vacancies.descriptionText:
Job Description

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is the world’s leading independent, end-to-end IT services company, helping clients harness the power of innovation to thrive on change. Created by the merger of CSC and the Enterprise Services business of Hewlett Packard Enterprise, DXC Technology serves nearly 6,000 private and public sector clients across 70 countries.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior SAP HCM Frontend with German working proficiency to join our BizDevOps team. This is a technical development and engineering role. You will design, write, test, and maintain code for SAP HCM systems.

Your primary focus will be full-stack development - building frontend SAP Fiori/UI5 applications.

You will also provide technical support, debugging, and code adjustments for SAP HCM Payroll (PY) and Time Management (TM).

Occasional travel (up to 5 times per year).

We are looking for a proactive, solution-oriented individual who is passionate about helping organizations optimize their human resources processes.

Technical Responsibilities

- Develop and deploy custom web applications using SAPUI5 and JavaScript. Extend and modify standard SAP Fiori applications, and configure the SAP Fiori Launchpad, tiles, and target mappings.
- Develop and maintain technical interfaces connecting SAP HCM with external platforms, such as SAP SuccessFactors and other software.
- Apply technical adjustments to payroll code, wage type logic configurations, and system parameters, including updates for year-end processing activities.
- Set up, automate, and monitor SAP background jobs and execution streams (using Streamworks). Prepare technical test scenarios, execute regression, and interface tests, and manage deployments within an Agile/DevOps pipeline using Jira and Confluence.

Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP software development.
- Practical knowledge of SAPUI5, JavaScript.
- Technical understanding of database tables, clusters, and data models within SAP Personnel Administration (PA), Organizational Management (OM), Payroll (PY) and Time Management (TM). Functional knowledge in some of these SAP HCM modules is an advantage.
- Practical experience using Jira and Confluence within an Agile/BizDevOps team setup.
- Working proficiency in German (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications

- SAP certifications in SAP Fiori/UI5 Development.
- Experience building integrations using SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) or SuccessFactors APIs.

What We Offer

- End-to-end involvement from bid to project completion
- Continuous learning through advanced presales enablement programs and SAP certifications
- Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies and innovation labs
- Flexible work model (offices: Warsaw, Krakow, Wroclaw, Gdansk) and people-centric culture
- Substantial medical insurance package provided in cooperation with the biggest medical services provider in Poland
- Life insurance package
- Multisport Card
- Advancement opportunities within the organization (a variety of interesting projects with the array of technologies and tools)
- Unlimited access to DXC University with courses from a bunch of external partners for the best learner's experience (e.g. Udemy)
- DXC Partner courses and certifications (Microsoft, SAP, ServiceNow, AWS, Google, Dell Technologies, IBM, Microfocus, Salesforce, Red Hat, Vmware, Workday)
- Employee Referral Program - financial bonus for the referrer for successful candidate recommendation
- Opportunity to join the numerous charity and ecology-related events organized by our CSR Team (Corporate Social Responsibility)
- Dixi Cool activities: trips, sports and wellness events, discounts for cultural events
- Employee Recognition Program with points assigned by colleagues for the recognized employees (exchangeable for prizes)
- Employee Assistance Program (providing 24/7 support for employees and their families in difficult life situations)

Thank you for taking time reviewing our job ad. If you believe this is the right match for you, please do not hesitate to apply. We are eager to learn more about you!

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf.
